result.brief: 提出几何感知的潜在世界模型 GWM-VLA，用多视角几何状态编码与目标视角 patch token 预测，并以共享潜在动作表征联合监督流匹配动作头，提升 VLA 在视觉与环境变化下的鲁棒性。
result.reason: Geometry-aware latent world model for VLA: multi-view state encoding, next-step target-view token prediction, latent-action representations. Directly matches embodied world modeling and planning control.
